items.title: Write up project plan for Generative Design Patterns
items.note:
There are two core components to this project
1. Generating UIs through a design space of various UI design patterns
2. Understanding how UI/UX Designers will create GenUI applications, and how this workflow of "GenUI Design" differs from traditional UI Design

A question to really ask myself is -- who are these UI/UX Designers for??? Who do we want to benefit? End-users building their own apps? Software tools that have GenUI integrated into their tools? What will it be? What's the biggest impact group?
